name: Edging — Pause Edging
summary: Stop all touch completely just before orgasm, wait until the impending feeling is gone, then start over from warmup. Most time-consuming but leads to the most intense pleasure. Used by about 35% of edgers.
detailed_description: Pause edging is the most complete form of backing off: all stimulation stops just before climax. The break can range from a minute to several hours, depending on what works. After the urge subsides, stimulation restarts from initial warmup. It's the slowest method but is associated with the most intense release. Some people struggle to rebuild after a full stop—if so, the continuous variation is a better fit.
stepwise_structure: 1. Build until orgasm is just about to hit.
3. Wait until the impending-orgasm feeling fully fades (a minute up to several hours).

Stopping when close is frustrating but expected.
